steps.title: What is an FFT Spectrum plot?
steps.markdown:
The **FFT Spectrum** widget loads a captured CSV waveform and applies a Fast Fourier Transform to show the frequency content of each signal.

You can see the time-domain waveform, the frequency spectrum, and harmonic amplitude bars side by side. A THD (Total Harmonic Distortion) summary table is computed automatically.

In this tutorial you will add the widget, load the included sample CSV, and configure one channel to analyze.

steps.title: Create a pane
steps.markdown: Click the **Add pane** button in the dashboard header to create a new pane. The FFT Spectrum widget will live inside it.

steps.title: Add an FFT Spectrum widget
steps.markdown: Click the **Add widget** button on the pane, then select **FFT Spectrum Widget** from the widget picker. The editor will open automatically.

steps.title: Configure the channels
steps.markdown:
The sample CSV has been pre-loaded. Add a channel to analyse:

1. Leave **Type** as *Regular* and pick `Vgrid` from the **Y Variable** drop-down.
2. Click **Add channel**.
3. Click **Save**.

The widget will compute the FFT and display the frequency spectrum below.

steps.title: Tutorial complete
steps.markdown:
The FFT Spectrum widget is live. Try zooming into the spectrum, toggling the log scale, or adjusting the fundamental frequency to track different harmonics.

Come back to this tutorial from the **Tutorials** menu any time.
